decisions.statement:
.xlsx stays UNSUPPORTED deliberately. Spreadsheet parsing brings formula
evaluation, multiple sheets, and styling semantics that conflict with the
bounded-operation model. Docs may state this as a decided limitation, not
a gap: the correct guidance is "export to CSV first".
decisions.notes_md: Revisit only if the kernel gains a sheet-selection UI. Not before.

decisions.statement:
product-content owns all terminology copy across every surface. Any
reconciliation touching a term.canonical.* projection escalates to
product-content rather than auto-patching, except pure mechanical renames
already recorded in a release.
decisions.notes_md: Set alongside the Job→Task rename so future renames have one owner.

decisions.statement:
TIE-BREAK between release rel_2026_05_02_ios_launch (announced iOS
availability) and current T3 config (ios: false): CONFIG WINS. The iOS
launch was rolled back on 2026-05-18 for kernel cold-start latency. The
release record is retained as history — T4 is temporal — and documentation
must state iOS as unavailable until config changes.
decisions.notes_md: This is the standing resolution for the Phase-15 CONTRADICTION fixture.

decisions.statement:
Linear regression stays ENABLED. The operation is bounded, well-tested,
and used by the CLI examples; disabling it would orphan documented
workflows.
decisions.notes_md:
Phase-15 ambiguous_ownership fixture, record A of two — this and
dec_regression_flag_pause deliberately claim the same key with opposing
positions. Concord must escalate, never tie-break (invariant I7).

decisions.statement:
Linear regression should be PAUSED for the next release while the
statistics review of coefficient reporting is open. Docs should stop
recommending it until the review closes.
decisions.notes_md:
Phase-15 ambiguous_ownership fixture, record B of two — deliberately
opposes dec_regression_flag_keep on the same key. Neither record
supersedes the other; that is the point. Concord escalates to the
fact owner and resolves nothing.

decisions.statement:
Relay shipped Chat and a browser Terminal
(rel_2026_07_27_multi_surface_expansion) and no hand-authored
documentation page mentions either surface. Concord cannot observe this:
its extractors project registered facts onto existing text, so absence
produces no projection and no impact. Prose reconciliation is
deliberately deferred to the documentation project. This record is
itself the detection.
decisions.notes_md:
claims_fact_keys is deliberately empty: this record does not dispute any
fact's value, it attests a coverage state — claiming the availability
keys would manufacture a third standing conflict and dilute the two
curated ones. The failures page renders coverage_observation records in
its "Blind spots observed in production" section; the future
documentation project finds its mandate by filtering the product-truth
snapshot for this kind, and should retire this record with a superseding
one when prose coverage lands.
